### Section 3 — Recommended Approach

**Recommended option:**
```
Option C — Event-Driven Hybrid Architecture

Python core with:
- FastAPI (HTTP gateway + TradingView webhooks + WebSocket)
- Redis (message bus + real-time cache)
- pandas + pandas-ta (indicator calculation: MACD, EMA, Fibonacci)
- MetaTrader5 Python lib (execution engine, Windows-only)
- TimescaleDB / PostgreSQL (OHLCV + trade history)
- React + TradingView Lightweight Charts (dashboard)
- Anthropic Python SDK (Claude AI co-pilot)
- YAML strategy config files (human-readable strategy rules)
```

**Why this was recommended:**
```
Clean separation of concerns. Redis decouples signal ingestion from
execution (critical for safety). FastAPI handles TradingView webhooks
natively. Claude SDK plugs in as a service. Scalable without a full
rewrite. Appropriate complexity for solo/small team.
```

**Estimated effort:** L (Phase 1: 1 week, Phase 2: 1 week, Phase 3: 1 week = ~3 weeks total for full MVP)

**Risks or caveats:**
```
- MT5 Python lib is Windows-only — cloud deployment is constrained
- Auto-trading = real money — ALWAYS test on MT5 demo first
- TradingView webhook has 15min delay on free plan — use MT5 feed as primary
- Fibonacci levels must recompute per candle close, not on every tick
- Claude API costs for real-time analysis — cache responses where possible
```

---

### Section 4 — Acceptance Criteria

**Phase 1 Done when:**
```
Given MT5 is running and connected
When the Python engine starts
Then it ingests OHLCV candles for XAUUSD/H1, computes MACD/EMA/Fib
     levels correctly, and stores them to TimescaleDB
```

**Phase 2 Done when:**
```
Given a TradingView Pine Script alert fires
When the webhook POST hits /webhook/tradingview
Then the strategy engine evaluates entry conditions, and if valid,
     places a trade on MT5 demo with correct lot size and SL/TP
```

**Phase 3 Done when:**
```
Given the system is running
When the user opens the React dashboard
Then they see live positions, P&L, trade log, and can ask Claude
     questions about the current market context
```

**Regression guard:**
```
- Manual trade commands must not be blocked by the auto-strategy engine
- Risk manager must hard-block trades exceeding max daily loss
- MT5 connection loss must pause auto-trading (not crash)
```

## TECH STACK

| Layer             | Tech                    |
|-------------------|-------------------------|
| MT5 bridge        | MetaTrader5 (Python)    |
| HTTP/Webhooks     | FastAPI + uvicorn       |
| Message bus       | Redis (pub/sub + cache) |
| Analysis          | pandas + pandas-ta      |
| Candle patterns   | python-candlestick/TA-Lib |
| DB (time-series)  | TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL) |
| Dashboard         | React + TradingView LW Charts |
| AI co-pilot       | Anthropic Python SDK    |
| Strategy config   | YAML files              |

## MVP PHASES

Phase 1 — Core Engine (Week 1)
- MT5 connection + price feed
- OHLCV ingestion to TimescaleDB
- pandas-ta indicators (MACD, EMA, Fibonacci)
- Manual order execution via Python CLI

Phase 2 — Strategy + Auto-Trade (Week 2)
- YAML strategy config loader
- Signal evaluation engine
- TradingView webhook receiver
- Auto-execution with risk manager

Phase 3 — Dashboard + AI (Week 3)
- FastAPI REST + WebSocket
- React dashboard with live chart
- Trade log + P&L tracking
- Claude AI chat endpoint
